note: No queryable zoning district service found for Lenawee County or its cities. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub for Lenawee returned only parcels, roads, townships, and similar layers; the county parcel layer (Lenawee_Parcels_Public, FeatureServer/2) has no zoning field. City of Adrian and Morenci zoning maps are published only as PDF images (Region 2 Planning index), and Tecumseh/Hudson have only PDFs or third-party sites (zoneomics, Regrid commercial data), which are not official services.
